concepts.title: Panchayati Raj: Self-Government in Villages
concepts.definition: Panchayati Raj is a system of local self-government in rural India: villagers manage their own affairs through panchayats at village, block and district levels, bringing governance close to the people.
concepts.formula: panchayati raj = village + block + district levels
concepts.key_idea: Self-government means villagers decide local matters themselves instead of running to the state or national capital.

concepts.title: The Gram Sabha: Assembly of All Adults
concepts.definition: The gram sabha is the general body of all registered adult villagers; it meets to discuss village needs, approve plans and budgets, and hold the elected panchayat answerable.
concepts.key_idea: Direct democracy lives in the gram sabha: every adult has a seat and a voice before the elected members act.

concepts.title: The Gram Panchayat and Its Members
concepts.definition: Villagers elect ward members and a sarpanch to form the gram panchayat, which carries out the gram sabha's decisions, maintains water, roads and records, and levies small local taxes for village work.
concepts.key_idea: Elected representatives do the day-to-day work, but they answer to the gram sabha that chose them.

concepts.title: Lakshmanpur: A Village Case Study
concepts.definition: Lakshmanpur, a village of about 200 houses in the Himalayan foothills, shows local government at work: farmers' needs for water, roads and a school, disputes and resources, all settled through the panchayat system.
concepts.key_idea: A concrete village turns civics into life: every need, from a broken road to a stolen crop, reaches the panchayat first.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Why is the gram sabha called the base of the Panchayati Raj structure?

solution_template.explain: The diagram runs from village base to district top, and the base is the gram sabha.
All adult villagers sit in it, so the elected panchayat below must act on its decisions.

worked_examples.question_pattern: How does a village road get repaired through panchayati raj?

solution_template.explain: Villagers place the damaged road before the gram sabha.
The gram panchayat plans the repair, arranges funds and gets the work done, reporting back to the sabha.
